kai: Hey folks — small maintenance thing: the ruby gem build is failing on M1 in the examples CI (`gem native extension` during bundle install). Happens only on macOS runners. Any idea if we broke a dependency in 0.8.2?

rachael: Ugh, saw that on a PR earlier. Error log looked like `make: *** No rule to make target` from the nokogiri native install. Can you paste the failing CI job link?

kai: https://ci.company/98765/jobs/45 — here's the snippet: ```
Installing nokogiri 1.14.5 with native extensions
current directory: /workspace/vendor/bundle/ruby/3.1.0/gems/nokogiri-1.14.5/ext/nokogiri
/usr/bin/ruby -I /usr/lib/ruby/3.1.0 -r ./siteconf2026.rb extconf.rb
checking for libxml2... yes
making "Makefile"
make: *** No rule to make target `libxml2.la'. Stop.
```

matt: That suggests the runner image doesn't have the system libxml2 dev package. We updated the dockerfile in examples to a slimmer image in Jan. The linux images include libxml2-dev but macos hosted runners rely on brew. CI job probably uses macos-latest which got updated.

rachael: For parity we usually pin the example app to use the portable precompiled nokogiri by setting `NOKOGIRI_USE_SYSTEM_LIBRARIES=false` in the bundler env. But that can hide real native-dep problems for integrators.

kai: Given this is a sampleapp aimed at onboarding users, I'd prefer to make the CI fast and green. Proposal: update examples/docker-setup and macos job to set `NOKOGIRI_USE_SYSTEM_LIBRARIES=false` and add a note in README about production builds requiring system libs.

matt: Agree for examples. Meanwhile, we should open an infra ticket for our mac runners so they install libxml2 via brew to catch regressions.

ci-bot: Created issue examples/430 "macOS CI: nokogiri native build failure on examples" — https://git.company/examples/issues/430

rachael: Also FYI I spotted an unrelated ruby-sdk parity gap: Go and Python SDKs have `retry_on_5xx` configuration and Ruby doesn't. Might be worth addressing while we touch retry code in the SDK.

kai: Good call. We can keep the sampleapp fix separate but add a follow-up in the SDK to match retry options. If someone wants to pick it up: add `retry_on_server_errors: {max_attempts: 3, jitter: true}` default off for now.

matt: I'll file an SDK issue and throw up a small design note.

ci-bot: PR opened examples#795 "ci: set NOKOGIRI_USE_SYSTEM_LIBRARIES=false for mac jobs" (linked to issue examples/430)

kai: Thanks! One final tiny ask: can we include a sentence in examples/README "If you see native extension failures on macOS, try exporting NOKOGIRI_USE_SYSTEM_LIBRARIES=false or ensure libxml2 is installed via homebrew"? Really helps new contributors.

docs-bot: Created docs suggestion in examples/docs#12 — "macOS native build troubleshooting"

rachael: Nice catch, kai. I'll review the PR and the SDK issue when matt posts it.

matt: Posted sdk#210 "ruby: add retry_on_server_errors parity with go/python" with a suggested API surface. Assigning @rachael for review.

kai: Awesome, thanks y'all. Saved me a frantic local debug :relieved:
